title: Liminal Architect
description: This modpack is fitted with all the neccessary mods for normal building, furniture mods, optimisation mods and a bunch of creepy shaders for your best liminal creations
body:
This modpack is fitted with all the neccessary mods for normal building, furniture mods, optimisation mods and a bunch of creepy shaders for your best liminal creations.
The modpack is here purely to help people set up some uncanny images and worlds.
